name: NGC 3628 - Hamburger Galaxy
description: The edge-on member of the Leo Triplet, warped and split lengthwise by a broad dust lane.

name: NGC 4565 - Needle Galaxy
description: A textbook edge-on spiral in Coma Berenices, seen almost exactly side-on with a fine central dust lane.

name: NGC 6992 - Eastern Veil Nebula
description: The eastern arc of the Cygnus Loop, a supernova remnant that has been expanding for thousands of years.

name: M31 - Andromeda Galaxy
description: The nearest large galaxy to the Milky Way, a spiral about 2.5 million light-years away in Andromeda, flanked by its satellites M32 and M110.

name: M44 - Beehive Cluster
description: A large, near naked-eye open cluster in Cancer, known to observers since antiquity.

name: NGC 869 - Double Cluster (NGC 869)
description: One half of the Double Cluster in Perseus, a pair of bright young open clusters a few hundred light-years apart.

name: M64 - Black Eye Galaxy
description: A spiral in Coma Berenices with a dark band of dust drawn across the near side of its core.

name: M104 - Sombrero Galaxy
description: An edge-on spiral in Virgo with a bright bulge and a hard, straight dust lane across its disc.

name: M11 - Wild Duck Cluster
description: A rich, compact open cluster in Scutum, set against the dense star fields of the Scutum Cloud.

name: M1 - Crab Nebula
description: The expanding debris of a supernova seen from Earth in 1054, in Taurus, with a pulsar at its heart.

name: NGC 2244 - Rosette Nebula
description: The open cluster at the centre of the Rosette Nebula in Monoceros, its hot young stars lighting the surrounding gas.

name: M101 - Pinwheel Galaxy
description: A large face-on spiral in Ursa Major, roughly 21 million light-years off, with noticeably asymmetric arms.

name: NGC 7635 - Bubble Nebula
description: A shell of gas blown outward by the wind of one massive hot star in Cassiopeia.

name: The Moon
description: Home turf, and the target that started all of this. Phases, terminator detail, and the occasional eclipse.

name: M106 - Galaxy in Canes Venatici
description: A bright spiral in Canes Venatici whose extra 'anomalous' arms are driven by an active galactic core.

name: M27 - Dumbbell Nebula
description: A bright planetary nebula in Vulpecula, among the first ever catalogued.

name: M33 - Triangulum Galaxy
description: The third-largest member of the Local Group, a loose face-on spiral in Triangulum.

name: M17 - Omega Nebula
description: A bright emission and star-forming region in Sagittarius, also called the Swan or the Omega.

name: IC 434 - Horsehead Nebula
description: The emission ridge in Orion behind the Horsehead, a column of dark dust silhouetted against the glow.

name: Comet Tsuchinshan-ATLAS
description: A long-period comet, C/2023 A3, that swung through the inner solar system in the autumn of 2024.

name: April 8, 2024 Total Solar Eclipse
description: The Great North American Eclipse — a total solar eclipse whose path of totality crossed from Mexico through Texas and up into the northeast on 8 April 2024.

name: August 21, 2017 Total Solar Eclipse
description: August 21, 2017 Total Solar Eclipse.

name: Lunar Airliner Transit
description: An airliner crossing the face of the Moon — a single frame, caught on the 22nd of August 2026.
